headlines.title: Hackers targeted municipal water systems in 7 states this week, FBI says
headlines.description: Cyberattacks targeting municipal water systems have been reported in at least seven states this week, prompting the FBI and the Environmental Protection Agency to warn utilities nationwide that hackers are trying to disrupt critical water infrastructure.

headlines.title: Gay cruise denied access to some ports despite booming LGBTQ+ tourism industry
headlines.description: Turkey and Egypt blocked a gay-themed cruise from docking at its ports on a recent Mediterranean trip. It's raising questions about how these policies could hurt their economies as the LGBTQ+ tourism industry booms. NBC News' Steven Romo reports.

headlines.title: How French wine country is dealing with fallout from wildfires
headlines.description: As firefighters in France continue to battle the wildfires, the French government is telling tourists the country is still safe to come visit. NBC News’ Raf Sanchez visited a winery in Bordeaux to hear how it’s being impacted by the lack of tourism.

headlines.title: Federal Reserve Leaves Interest Rates Unchanged
headlines.description: The Federal Reserve left its key interest rate unchanged on Wednesday for the fifth consecutive meeting. The decision comes despite lingering concerns about persistently high inflation.

headlines.title: August 2026 Freebies: School Supplies, Root Beer Floats, More
headlines.description: From free root beer floats to complimentary admission to all national parks, NBC’s chief consumer investigative correspondent Vicky Nguyen joins TODAY with a roundup of ways to cash in on freebies for the month of August.

headlines.title: How grocery prices have changed since Trump took office
headlines.description: Learn where grocery prices stand during the Trump administration. See how inflation is affecting the cost of eggs, bread, chicken, ground beef and more.

headlines.title: Iran vows to ‘punish the aggressor today’ after U.S. unleashes ‘heavy wave’ of strikes
headlines.description: The conflict appeared to draw in new countries, as Egypt confirmed that a drone hit two natural gas vessels at one of its ports.

headlines.title: Track U.S., state and county gas prices
headlines.description: Are gas prices declining? NBC News is tracking national, state and county prices at the pump.

headlines.title: Trump announces plans for sprawling Dulles Airport makeover
headlines.description: The plans include redoing two of the concourses and removing the airport’s aging shuttles, known as “people movers.”

headlines.title: Fed holds interest rates for the fifth meeting this year, underscoring inflation fears
headlines.description: The decision was largely expected by investors, who have seen markets begin to churn amid ongoing concerns about higher oil prices and AI spending.

headlines.title: Nasdaq-100 slides into correction as global chip and memory stocks sell off
headlines.description: Chip stocks around the world sold off sharply, the latest chapter in the monthslong jitters surrounding artificial intelligence, memory and chip stocks.

headlines.title: Oil prices slide as U.S. and Iran pause strikes to give ‘space’ for diplomacy
headlines.description: The two sides halted fire over the weekend, following 13 nights of attacks that threatened new pain for the global economy.
